fixes.en:
In Battroid mode, chain melee attacks
while holding Down on the D-pad
to perform a launching melee attack.
fixes.why: D-pad direction capitalised (Up/Down/Left/Right) to match the tutorial convention used in the neighbouring rows of the same screens (e.g. 743, 856).

fixes.en:
While guarding, press Up, Left or Right
on the D-pad to move
without dropping your guard.
fixes.why: D-pad direction capitalised (Up/Down/Left/Right) to match the tutorial convention used in the neighbouring rows of the same screens (e.g. 743, 856).

fixes.en:
While hovering, press Left or Right on the D-pad
to strafe sideways while still facing forward.
fixes.why: D-pad direction capitalised (Up/Down/Left/Right) to match the tutorial convention used in the neighbouring rows of the same screens (e.g. 743, 856).

fixes.en:
Press Up on the D-pad to pitch down,
and Down on the D-pad to pitch up.
fixes.why: D-pad direction capitalised (Up/Down/Left/Right) to match the tutorial convention used in the neighbouring rows of the same screens (e.g. 743, 856).

fixes.en: Press Left or Right on the D-pad to roll.
fixes.why: D-pad direction capitalised (Up/Down/Left/Right) to match the tutorial convention used in the neighbouring rows of the same screens (e.g. 743, 856).

fixes.en:
Hold the L button and press Left or Right
on the D-pad to yaw.
fixes.why: D-pad direction capitalised (Up/Down/Left/Right) to match the tutorial convention used in the neighbouring rows of the same screens (e.g. 743, 856).

fixes.en:
Hold Up on the D-pad while locking on
to switch your lock to enemy aces
or disabled wingmen.
fixes.why: D-pad direction capitalised (Up/Down/Left/Right) to match the tutorial convention used in the neighbouring rows of the same screens (e.g. 743, 856).
